# SJF4J (Simple JSON Facade for Java)

> A unified structural processing layer built on JSON semantics. SJF4J processes native Java object graphs using consistent APIs for binding, navigation, validation, mapping, and patching.

SJF4J supports Java 8+ and provides flexible Runtime APIs and specialized compile-time generated APIs. The guides explain concepts, examples, and limitations. Follow their API Reference links to Javadoc for exact method signatures and contracts. Match Javadoc to your dependency version: the guides may describe features ahead of the latest published release.

## Getting started

- [Getting Started](https://sjf4j.org/docs/getting-started): Project overview and quick-start examples.
- [Installation](https://sjf4j.org/docs/installation): Dependencies and annotation processor setup.
- [OBNT (Object-Based Node Tree)](https://sjf4j.org/docs/modeling): The structural model behind SJF4J.
- [Compiled APIs](https://sjf4j.org/docs/compiled): Compile-time code generation.

## Features

- [Binding](https://sjf4j.org/docs/binding): Read and write structured data across backends.
- [Navigation](https://sjf4j.org/docs/navigating): JSONPath and JSON Pointer.
- [JSON Schema Validation](https://sjf4j.org/docs/validating): Runtime and compiled validation.
- [Object Mapping](https://sjf4j.org/docs/mapping): Map between Java object models.
- [JDBC Result Mapping](https://sjf4j.org/docs/jdbc-mapping): Compile-time JDBC row mapping.
- [JSON Patching](https://sjf4j.org/docs/patching): JSON Patch, Merge Patch, and indexed merge.
- [Backends & Formats](https://sjf4j.org/docs/backends): Supported formats and backend selection.
- [External Nodes](https://sjf4j.org/docs/external-nodes): Integrate third-party node representations.
- [Value Codecs](https://sjf4j.org/docs/value-codecs): Map custom Java value types.
- [Spring Integration](https://sjf4j.org/docs/spring-integration): Use SJF4J with Spring.

## API reference

- [Core API Javadoc](https://javadoc.io/doc/org.sjf4j/sjf4j-core/latest/): Latest published core API.
- [JSON Schema API Javadoc](https://javadoc.io/doc/org.sjf4j/sjf4j-schema/latest/): Latest published schema API.
- [Source code](https://github.com/sjf4j-projects/sjf4j): Implementation, releases, and examples.

## Optional

- [Extended overview](https://sjf4j.org/llms-full.txt): A longer summary of SJF4J for language models.
- [Benchmarks](https://sjf4j.org/docs/benchmarks): Performance results and methodology.
- [FAQ](https://sjf4j.org/docs/faq): Common questions and limitations.
